integrity: The proof independently derives the maximal-cyclic and order-\(p\) line partition, reduces zero forcing to an exact false-twin class-peeling criterion for \(p\ge3\), counts every peelable profile, and handles the \(p=2\) boundary by exhaustive exact enumeration.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the abelian group \(C_{p^2}\times C_p\).
No real minimum-rank or maximum-nullity formula is claimed.
The \(p=2\) case is a separate seven-vertex boundary because several structural classes are singletons.
Within this one-parameter family the graph order already determines \(p\), so the polynomial is not claimed as an independent group-reconstruction invariant.
title: Zero forcing polynomial of the non-cyclic graph of \(C_{p^2}\times C_p\)
